summary: Cartesian Growth Corp II, a blank-check SPAC, filed an 8-K reporting that on July 30, 2026 shareholders approved an amendment to extend the company's termination date from August 5, 2026 to August 5, 2027 to complete an initial business combination. The vote occurred at an extraordinary general meeting with approximately 89.2% of shares represented; the extension proposal passed with 7,870,808 votes for, none against. The amendment became effective upon approval. This is a routine SPAC extension filing, commonly used to provide additional time to find a target. Watch for future announcements regarding a potential business combination or liquidation if none is completed by the new deadline.
